description: Implementation of DomainService for managing domain entities, including CRUD operations, OAuth2 client updates, and domain info retrieval within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: DomainServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing domain management operations, including CRUD, OAuth2 client management, and domain info retrieval.

methods.name: saveDomain
methods.description: Validates and saves a domain entity, publishing a save event.

methods.name: updateOauth2Clients
methods.description: Updates OAuth2 clients associated with a domain, adding new and removing obsolete clients.

methods.name: deleteDomainById
methods.description: Deletes a domain by its ID and publishes a delete event.

methods.name: findDomainById
methods.description: Retrieves a domain entity by its ID.

methods.name: findDomainInfosByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves paginated domain info list for a tenant.

methods.name: findDomainInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed domain info by domain ID.

methods.name: isOauth2Enabled
methods.description: Checks if OAuth2 is enabled for a tenant.

methods.name: deleteDomainsByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all domains associated with a tenant.

methods.name: findEntity
methods.description: Finds an entity (domain) by ID, returning an optional.

methods.name: findEntityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an entity by ID.

methods.name: deleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes an entity (domain) by ID within a transaction.

methods.name: getDomainInfo
methods.description: Constructs DomainInfo object including OAuth2 clients for a domain.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is DOMAIN.
